title: RiO-DETRv2: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Modeling Meets Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer

problem.summary: RiO-DETR is the first real-time end-to-end transformer for oriented object detection, yet further localization gains require a more expressive box representation.
statements: RiO-DETR is the first real-time end-to-end transformer for oriented object detection, yet further localization gains require a more expressive box representation.

Although distributional regression has succeeded in horizontal DETRs, extending it to oriented detection introduces geometry-misaligned boundary modeling and topology-inconsistent orientation refinement.
We present RiO-DETRv2, a geometry-aware uncertainty modeling framework for real-time oriented object detection.

background.summary: Oriented object detection extends horizontal bounding boxes to localize objects with arbitrary rotations (Oriented Bounding Boxes, OBB), which is crucial for aerial imagery, remote sensing, and scene text understanding (Xia et al. 2018; Ding et al. 2021; Cheng et al. 2022; Zhou et al. 2022; Redmon et al. 2016; Zou et al. 2023).
